name: SaleSaver
author: Matt Biscay

sections.description:
SaleSaver helps you recover lost sales by sending recovery emails to customers whose orders failed during checkout. This WooCommerce extension gives you the tools to re-engage customers and complete their purchases.

Free Features:

  • Custom email template integrated with WooCommerce email system
  • Send recovery emails to customers with failed orders
  • Bulk email sending from admin interface
  • Duplicate order detection to avoid spamming customers
  • Customizable email subject, heading, and content
  • Both HTML and plain text email formats
  • Order management tools for failed orders
  • Tracks last recovery email sent timestamp and count per order
  • Prevents duplicate sends — already-emailed orders are skipped automatically
  • Signed unsubscribe links and opt-out management
  • Recovery dashboard with sent and recovered-order activity
  • WooCommerce order attribution when a contacted order is paid
  • Full WooCommerce email settings integration

How It Works:

  1. When an order fails during checkout, it’s marked as “failed” in WooCommerce
  2. Navigate to SaleSaver in your WordPress admin sidebar
  3. View failed orders with customer details
  4. Select specific orders or send recovery emails to eligible failed orders
  5. Customers receive a recovery email with their order details and a direct link to complete payment

Pro Features:

Pro users can recover pending-payment and on-hold orders, automate initial and follow-up campaigns, process bulk sends in the background, track signed email opens and recovery-link clicks, verify addresses with Reoon, use AJAX bulk actions, review activity and security events, and use persistent object caching where available.

Perfect For:

  • Recovering failed payment transactions
  • Reducing cart abandonment
  • Increasing conversion rates
  • Re-engaging customers who experienced checkout issues

Additional Information

Support: For support, please visit https://mattbiscay.com

Privacy: Recovery emails use your existing WordPress mail system. SaleSaver stores recovery activity on WooCommerce orders. If a Pro merchant enables engagement tracking, signed open and click events are stored on the order. If the merchant connects Reoon, selected customer email addresses are sent to Reoon for verification under the merchant’s Reoon account and privacy terms.

Compatibility: Tested with WooCommerce 11.0 and WordPress 7.0+
sections.installation:
1. Upload the salesaver folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Configure email settings at WooCommerce → Settings → Emails → SaleSaver Recovery Email
  5. Send recovery emails from SaleSaver in the admin sidebar
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

Can I customize the email template?

Yes! You can customize the email subject, heading, and additional content from WooCommerce → Settings → Emails → SaleSaver Recovery Email. For advanced customization, you can override the template files in your theme.

How do I override the email template?

Copy the template files from plugins/salesaver/templates/emails/ to your theme folder at your-theme/woocommerce/emails/ and customise as needed.

Will this send multiple emails to the same customer?

SaleSaver highlights duplicate orders (same email address) so you can avoid sending multiple emails. Use the “Select Duplicates Only” button to manage these. Additionally, orders that have already received a recovery email are automatically skipped on subsequent runs.

Can I schedule emails to send automatically?

Automatic initial and follow-up recovery campaigns are available in SaleSaver Pro. Free users can send recovery emails manually from the SaleSaver order list.

Does this track which orders received recovery emails?

Yes. SaleSaver records the send timestamp and send count per order (visible in the “Last Sent” column on the SaleSaver page). An order note is also added for audit purposes.

Does SaleSaver track email opens and clicks?

Pro users can enable Email Engagement Tracking. Open tracking uses a signed one-pixel image and click tracking uses a signed redirect to the order-payment page. Tracking is disabled unless the merchant enables it.

Can SaleSaver avoid invalid email addresses?

Pro users can connect a Reoon account to check addresses. Addresses explicitly reported as invalid or disabled are blocked from recovery sends; unchecked or inconclusive addresses are not automatically blocked.

What happens to plugin data when I uninstall?

The plugin will clean up its settings when uninstalled. Order notes are preserved by default to maintain order history.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • Includes the complete SaleSaver 2.0 dashboard, automation, engagement-tracking, deliverability, activity-log, and scalability feature set.
  • Assigns mattbiscay.com as the WooCommerce order Origin only after a contacted order is paid.
  • Reconciles historical attribution by attributing paid recoveries and clearing premature SaleSaver attribution from unpaid orders.
  • Displays the SaleSaver Origin exactly as mattbiscay.com in WooCommerce Orders.
  • Fixes AJAX progress indicators remaining hidden during email, deletion, and Reoon verification batches.
  • Prevents browser-restored checkbox state from selecting replacement orders after deletion.
  • Reports the number of orders deleted rather than the number of deletion events.
  • Adds a one-click control for selecting orders with email addresses marked invalid by Reoon.

2.0.0

  • Added a recovery dashboard with sent, opened, clicked, recovered-order, revenue, campaign, template, status, product, and deliverability metrics.
  • Added Pro automated initial and follow-up recovery campaigns.
  • Added signed Pro email open and recovery-link click tracking.
  • Added Pro deliverability reporting and invalid-address send blocking through Reoon results.
  • Integrated security events into dashboard activity while retaining the detailed exportable log.
  • Added clearer enabled/disabled states throughout Pro settings.
  • Added order-status filtering, clearer selection controls, opt-out cleanup tools, and improved AJAX bulk actions.
  • Added WooCommerce order attribution using mattbiscay.com when a contacted order is subsequently paid.
  • Added a resumable attribution reconciliation that attributes recovered paid orders and clears premature attribution from unpaid orders.
  • Fixed automation scans so large stores cannot starve eligible orders beyond the oldest 100.
  • Bounded dashboard, migration, and purchase-suppression queries for safer operation on large stores.
  • Fixed Free/Pro package detection, activation behavior, branding assets, and Freemius integration.

1.0.6

  • Fixed Pro builds rendering as Free when the cached license entitlement is temporarily unavailable.
  • Load the Pro interface based on package identity while continuing to gate paid behavior by license entitlement.
  • Show a clear license activation warning in inactive Pro builds instead of the Free upgrade offer.

1.0.5

  • Added a distinct salesaver-pro package slug so activating Pro automatically deactivates the Free version without deleting it.
  • Added an explicit Freemius plugin icon hook and bundled slug-based icon fallback.
  • Added standard 772×250 and 1544×500 PNG banners for the WordPress.org plugin directory.

1.0.4

  • Centralized Free and Pro send tracking so every delivery path records through the same verified persistence flow.
  • Fixed duplicate tracking increments in Pro AJAX and background sends.
  • Added post-save verification and a visible administrator warning when tracking metadata cannot be persisted.
  • Added SaleSaver version, build fingerprint, and HPOS state to WordPress Site Health information.
  • Added release checks for generated Free and Pro packages.

1.0.3

  • Added French (fr_FR) translations for SaleSaver email content and email settings.
  • Added stock-aware recovery eligibility so orders with unavailable or insufficient product stock are not sent recovery emails.
  • Added a Pro-only Stock column showing current available stock for each product in an order.
  • Added Pro Reoon bulk email verification with asynchronous task polling and per-order results.

1.0.2

  • Added Freemius integration for Pro licensing, entitlement checks, and premium feature gating
  • Added a Pro settings area for configuring recovery and performance features
  • Added background recovery-email processing through WooCommerce Action Scheduler with staggered delivery
  • Added recovery-email tracking with send timestamps, send counts, and duplicate-send prevention
  • Added AJAX bulk email sending and order deletion with batched processing and real-time progress
  • Added security event logging with user, IP, timestamp, event filtering, 90-day retention, and CSV export
  • Added persistent object-cache integration with cache invalidation for supported WordPress cache backends
  • Added a dedicated pending-payment recovery email
  • Free recovery is limited to failed orders; Pro users can also recover pending-payment and on-hold orders
  • Applied Pro status selection consistently to sending, background processing, bulk actions, counts, pagination, and caching
  • Added signed per-order unsubscribe links and administrator re-subscribe controls
  • Added Freemius-managed uninstall cleanup for plugin settings, scheduled actions, tracking metadata, and security logs
  • Updated documentation for current free and Pro behavior

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Custom WooCommerce email integration
  • Bulk email sending functionality
  • Duplicate order detection
  • Admin interface for managing failed orders
  • HTML and plain text email templates
  • Customizable email settings
  • Order note tracking
